glosses: lesson (a section of learning or teaching)
lesson (something to learn or be learned)
lesson (something that serves as a warning or encouragement)

examples.text: Ella toma lecciones de piano una vez a la semana.
examples.en: She takes piano lessons once a week.

examples.text: Él no disfrutó de sus lecciones.
examples.en: He did not enjoy his lessons.
